The Problem
:::

## The High Cost of Disconnected HR Data

For many HR Directors and business leaders, answering a simple question like *"What is our turnover rate correlated with recent compensation changes?"* is an agonizing, multi-day process.

Why? Because HR data is inherently messy and scattered. Your recruitment data lives in an Applicant Tracking System (ATS), compensation sits in Payroll, employee sentiment is trapped in a survey platform, and historical performance reviews are buried in endless Excel spreadsheets.
:::

::: {.service-section}
::: {.section-label}
Where the work gets stuck
:::

The siloed architecture creates severe bottlenecks:

::: {.offering-list}
::: {.offering-item}
### Wasted Time

Your HR team spends hours every week manually exporting CSVs, running complex VLOOKUPs, and cleaning data instead of actually analyzing it.
:::

::: {.offering-item}
### Reactive Blind Spots

By the time a report is compiled, the data is already stale, making it impossible to proactively address flight risks or burnout.
:::

::: {.offering-item}
### Data Trust Issues

When leadership gets conflicting numbers because "my spreadsheet hasn't been updated yet," trust in HR metrics erodes.
:::
:::
:::

## The Architecture: Unifying Your People Data

To solve this, we don't need to replace your existing HR software. Instead, we build an automated bridge.

Below is the architecture strategy I use to pull data out of isolated silos and organize it into a single, highly secure data warehouse.
:::
:::

## The Solution Strategy: Why Google BigQuery?

For Small to Medium-Sized Businesses (SMBs), building a data warehouse might sound like an expensive, enterprise-only endeavor. But **Google BigQuery** is cheap and scalable, making it the absolute best choice for growing HR teams:
:::
:::

::: {.offering-list}
::: {.offering-item}
### Cost-Effective (Pay-As-You-Go)

You don't need to buy massive servers. BigQuery is "serverless," meaning you only pay for the exact queries you run. For most SMB HR datasets, the storage and processing costs are mere pennies a month.
:::

::: {.offering-item}
### Enterprise-Grade Security

HR data is highly sensitive. BigQuery is backed by Google’s world-class security infrastructure, allowing us to set strict access controls. We can easily mask sensitive fields (like salaries or social security numbers) so only authorized leadership can view them.
:::

::: {.offering-item}
### Zero-Maintenance Scalability

Whether your company has 50 employees or 5,000, BigQuery handles the load effortlessly. As your business grows, your data architecture doesn't have to change.
:::

::: {.offering-item}
### Seamless Integration

It connects natively to powerful Business Intelligence tools, turning raw code into beautiful, interactive dashboards that anyone on the executive team can understand.
:::
:::
